items.text: Task 1 — doorway: demote the universal claims-302. Default subview → ServeShell (was RedirectToMount); /epr/{id} always serves the shell. Don't touch sitemap or the legacy /lamad/resource alias-302. TDD inverts the classify claimed test.

Task 2 — shell KEYSTONE: focal epr-composite renderer. Register an epr-composite renderer rendering the composite body (sections→items) as an accessible outline, item refs as /epr/{ref} links (eprToUniversalHref). data-testid root. Vitest. Without it, paths fall to the raw fallback post-demotion.

Task 3 — shell: Open-in-{pillar} affordance in content-viewer when contentType is claimed (path→/lamad/path/{id}), plain cross-bundle href. Derive mount from contentType→pillar map (reuse bundle route context; minimal map + backlog capture if none). data-testid. Vitest.

Task 4 — a2o: INVERT deep-link-delivery.feature:54 (the 302-to-mount scenario) → /epr/{claimed-path} renders the lens-complete viewer (focal composite outline + knowledge leg + Open-in-pillar affordance), no 302. Add selectors/steps; @regression; testid-sync. Opus authors narrative.
